objective: Candidate sifts finishing media from washers; PR 2130 empties food scraps from a sink strainer into a caddy and replaces the strainer.

success_condition: PR 2130 rewards the number of scraps in the caddy, final basket seating, and hand clearance, with permanent failures for drain/counter loss or dropping. reason: This is the closest structural match, but the decisive ability differs: complete basket emptying versus selective many-body screening with simultaneous retention.
